text:
olivia: quick note - running loadgen against quickstart JS shows a weird burst pattern in pagination. behavior: steady requests then a 2-4s pause then ~10 requests fire at once for many users. repro: loadgen --clients=30 --pages=6 --mix=search:heavy,embed:light

dan: which SDK and sampleapp commit?

olivia: js-sdk@0.10.1, sampleapp main. logs attached excerpt:
```
WARN limiter: queued (scope=global) inflight=160
DEBUG paginator: holding cursor for permit, page=4
INFO auth: refresh triggered by caller=alpha
INFO retry: attempt=1 immediate_requeue=true
ERROR api: 403 token invalid (transient)
```

prasanna: immediate_requeue=true stands out. Our retry code path currently bypasses client limiter for speed, which can backfire when auth refreshes happen concurrently.

jo: we added that bypass to reduce tail latency in single-request failures, but didn't think about heavy concurrent paginators.

olivia: additional note: sampleapp creates one client per process and shares limiter across routes. embed-heavy traffic starving search cursinators.

dan: proposed fixes:
- require retry to acquire limiter permit (no bypass flag)
- add optional limiter.scope config: global|per-client|per-route (default global)
- implement singleflight token refresh in js-sdk auth so concurrent refreshes dedupe
- change paginator to return current page while prefetching next page token async (config PREFETCH_NEXT=true)

prasanna: agree. For singleflight: Map<key,Promise> with TTL slightly < token ttl. On refresh start set promise, others await. On success resolve and delete; on failure delete and propagate. unit tests mandatory.

jo: can we instead spin up separate clients per logical route in sampleapp as short-term mitigation? That should prevent cross-route permit stealing.

olivia: yes using separate clients reduces interference immediately. I'll add that to the repro harness and doc the workaround.

dan: tests: add e2e that runs mixed routes for 90s and asserts no >3s stall and no >5 concurrent auth 5xxs. also add unit test to ensure retry path does not set immediate_requeue flag.

ci-bot: please open issue area/devex and tag test/e2e and priority/medium. link PRs with canary rollout plan.

prasanna: i'll own auth singleflight impl. jo will take limiter scope change. olivia will update sampleapp and tests. timeline: draft PRs by EOD Thursday, canary next week.

olivia: thanks all. i'll post the draft links and add the loadgen commands to the issue. :sparkles:
